Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now.

Neptune, your ruling planet and keeper of the water element, squares Uranus in the 7th House, stirring restless emotions and sudden shifts. Venus trines the 10th House, smoothing career and boosting a modest bonus. This water‑element clash also spurs creative inspiration, urging you to journal your deepest feelings for clarity.

In love, the Neptune‑Uranus square urges bold adventure—singles attract an exotic traveler, couples must curb impulsive arguments. Expect a surprising compliment from an unexpected source that may open a new romance door.

Career shines as Venus trines the 10th House, bringing a surprise promotion, yet Mercury's shadow in the 2nd House warns against reckless spending. Consider a side project that aligns with your values; it could attract unexpected investors.

Skip any contract under the square's pressure; you'll miss a hidden gift this evening. Subscribe now for tomorrow's Pisces insight.
